title: Avarice
subtitle_it: voltando pesi per forza di poppa

exits.label: Return to Gluttony ←
exits.hint: di qua dal peso — return through the weighed gate; bank loot at the Dark Wood stash

pois.label: Ledger Bell
pois.hint: Ring it when Plutus swells with coin — it breaks him

pois.label: Ledger Cache
pois.hint: One weighed drop per visit — beyond the wasters' track

pois.label: Ledger Shrine
pois.hint: rebalance — restores life and breath (kneel at the measure)

pois.label: Dark Wood road
pois.hint: Once Plutus falls, the road home opens past the dais

pois.label: Ledger Stone
pois.hint: «Perché tieni?» «Perché burli?» — the weights clash where the road crosses their ring. Cross between clashes.

packs.name: Hoard Heart
packs.notes: Wards nearby weights until broken — the heart of the ring, between the processions

packs.name: Coin Wisps
packs.notes: Scattered greed; small, quick, easy to undervalue

packs.name: Road Weights
packs.notes: First counterweights past the shrine — spawn keep-out; learn the measure on the scorched road

packs.name: North Ledger
packs.notes: Hoarders' side, just outside the north track — lure them into a rolling weight

packs.name: South Balance
packs.notes: Wasters' side, outside the south track

packs.name: Weight Champions
packs.notes: Heavy measures north of the hoarders' track — gold trim, don't undervalue

packs.name: Stray Coin
packs.notes: Loose change inside the ring, between the processions

packs.name: Gold Chorus
packs.notes: South of the wasters' track — the lane is a weapon

packs.name: Crush Approach
packs.notes: North flank before the Crush dais — keep the approach readable

packs.name: Ledger Warden
packs.notes: Tablet shield beside the Counterweight, inside the ring before the east clash

packs.name: Counterweight
packs.notes: Mid-elite inside the ring: charges down a lane like the rolling weights (break its charge with a finisher); tip it before Plutus

packs.name: North Measure
packs.notes: Empty ledger flats north of the road — unpaid tallies drift

packs.name: South Spill
packs.notes: Coin spill south of the Crush lane — undervalue them and they swarm

packs.name: Northwest Drift
packs.notes: Drift weights on the scorched NW flats — fills the empty ledger corner

packs.name: Southwest Spill
packs.notes: Coin spill on empty SW flats — fills the ledger corner west of South Balance

packs.name: Southeast Drift
packs.notes: SE ledger flats past South Spill — unpaid weights drift off the Crush lane

bosses.name: Plutus
bosses.notes: «Pape Satàn, pape Satàn aleppe!» — swallows coin (Fiorini) and swells; the Ledger Bell breaks him; at half he hurls rolling weights

first_clear.notes: Plutus broken — Avarice yields its measure; return via Gluttony gate or bank at the Dark Wood stash

daily_quests.objective: Ring the Ledger Bell to still a pack or break a swollen Plutus
daily_quests.notes: Contrapasso of measure: still the weights, tip the Crush; shares UTC daily cap with Dark Wood writ

style_kit.notes: Circle kit 4 of 12; the two processions of rolling weights clash on the road; gold-on-black irony, Doré bone-gold

legal.notes: Names and short Italian tags only; original encounter design; no assets from other Dante games
